attacks.claim: The line 'freeze/heat protection is never interrupted' overstates the design, because relays are held off for about 90 s during install. The temperature gate (7-32 °C) makes this harmless in practice, but the wording is inaccurate.
attacks.evidence: "so freeze/heat protection is never interrupted" vs "During the ~90 s install, relays are held open (off)."

attacks.claim: The 4.7-edit-then-re-upgrade path and the stale-v2 discard are specified but have no QA row. A schedule edit made through app 9.2 on a 4.8 unit is also not described.
attacks.evidence: QA covers only "edit on 4.8, downgrade to 4.7 via OTA"

attacks.claim: Revert of a behavioral regression (for example HVAC faults) is a manual OTA push. It is subject to the install window and possibly the 14-day postpone, and no time-to-revert target is stated. Staged gates and the halt switch limit the exposure.
attacks.evidence: "Revert: push 4.7 to updated units through the same OTA path"
